summary: The comment expresses concern about the potential cost impact of ending the E-Rate program immediately, highlighting the need to preserve funding to avoid additional costs for network services and equipment replacement.

claims.argument: The program would cost an extra $337,219.20 annually if funding ended immediately
claims.evidence_quote: It is critical that the program not end, but I don't think they could eliminate the funding immediately. I personally think they will target removing funding for urban areas where there are less challenges with network/internet services, if any changes are made. If the program ended this year for current Network/Internet Services (Category 1, where we only pay 10% of the cost), it would cost us an extra $337,219.20 annually.
